digest.component_or_area: bridge projects store module and CLI/library/MCP surface
propositions: The bridge needs to record which tracker projects a store syncs and which repos each project belongs to in a store-level mapping at .bridge_state/projects.json, separate from bindings.json and prev_snapshot.json
resolve_project must implement tri-state logic: return legacy_default for absent keys, None for explicit empty string, the project key for set values, and None when legacy_default itself is empty
bridge projects subcommand must provide set, list, and remove operations with set requiring --repos argument (can be empty string) and replacing repos lists idempotently
An absent projects.json record is legal and reads as empty mapping with None legacy_default; a malformed record must raise an error rather than degrade gracefully
The same projects mapping must be readable and writable identically through CLI, library (lib_ops.py), and MCP (read and write tool) surfaces
Mapping writes must not mutate bindings.json or prev_snapshot.json and must leave them byte-identical before and after the operation
